body:
Amanda,

Lovely to finally meet you in that kitchen of yours. Two shots off my phone so you have them: the plate you made up with the pan card on it, and the tub the dressing came out of. Both are on your phone already, I airdropped them before I left.

On the sesame: we run a nut-free kitchen and that dressing is a seed paste, there are no nuts in it. I know you asked twice. You have my word on it, so please don't hold the tray up over that, we're already tight on the Sunday.

One favour and it makes my life easy. Send me over the allergy list off your meal card, names and what each of them reacts to, and I'll build the trays straight off it and label them myself so nobody has to guess on the day. No need to bug Amanda for a sign off, we did it exactly this way for the spring concert and it went fine.

Deposit invoice follows Monday. Any trouble, call me.

Rochelle
Piedmont Table Catering | 404-555-0293

Amanda
